data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Efficiency Improvement Suggestions
features.description: Provide suggestions for improving pipeline efficiency based on analysis.
acceptance_criteria: The system can generate suggestions for reducing execution time.
Users can view potential cost-saving measures.
Suggestions are based on historical data and trends.

features.title: Pipeline Performance Trend Analysis
features.description: Provide insights into pipeline performance trends over time.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view graphical representations of performance trends.
The system can identify and highlight significant performance changes.
Users can filter trends by specific time periods.

features.title: Stage Execution Time Analysis
features.description: Analyze and visualize execution times for different pipeline stages.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view execution times for each stage of the pipeline.
The system can compare execution times across different runs.
Users can identify stages with the longest execution times.

features.title: Cost Analysis
features.description: Perform cost analysis based on pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view cost breakdowns for pipeline executions.
The system can calculate total costs for specific time periods.
Users can identify stages contributing most to the cost.

features.title: Interactive Jupyter Notebook
features.description: Develop an interactive Jupyter notebook for analyzing pipeline execution data.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open and interact with the Jupyter notebook.
The notebook can import and process pipeline execution data.
Users can execute cells to perform data analysis.
